text: The hour has come, brothers of the High Council!
zh: 时刻已至，高等议会的兄弟们！

text: We shall no longer bow to divine hands!
zh: 我们再也不必向神明之手俯首！

text: No longer will our destiny be theirs to mold!
zh: 我们的命运再不由他们摆布！

text: Once this ritual is complete, we shall ascend as gods!
zh: 待此仪式完成，我们将飞升为神！

text:
And beyond that!
We shall rule over the very gods themselves!
zh:
不止于此！
我们还将凌驾于诸神之上！
